name: Suzumura Tamaki
source:
The main character of this story.
She is an ordinary human girl.
She becomes a “chosen maiden,” which she thought she had no chance of being, and gets sent to the upper world.
She is so kind that she is said to be good-natured, although sometimes she is a bit of a goofball, and people around her worry about her.
Yet, she also has a strong side, taking care of the household, her younger brother, and her mother.
